title: Kissed Crunchy Egyptian Bananas Fritters
description: A buttery, crunchy, and cozy Egyptian dessert featuring deep-fried bananas, perfect for warm weather and special occasions.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the melted butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, mix together cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the cornstarch mixture to the flour mixture and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Peel the bananas and cut them into 1-inch pieces.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Once the oil is hot, add a few pieces of banana and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried bananas from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat with the remaining banana pieces.
Dust the fried bananas with confectioners' sugar and drizzle with honey, if desired.
